Targeted extraction of a 100-page policy report whose quantitative content is (a) Appendix C Table 2 (MACC key inputs: printed), (b) the 2030/2050 MACC charts Figs. 16-18 (bar heights NOT printed), (c) Fig. 30 cost-gap panel (printed), (d) TRL/ARL in Fig. 34 and Sect. 4b text. Loaded (main): SMR natural-gas use and CO2 factor (GREET); electrolytic H2 levelized cost 2030/2050 (production derived as capex+opex components; delivered ranges from MACC footnotes); EFI CO2 capture costs (cost-levelized + opex per t CO2) for NGP, ammonia, FCC, ethylene cracker and SMR hosts; CO2 T&S $10-40/t; electric boiler capex/opex/efficiency/LCOH (Danish Energy Agency); low- and high-pressure TES capex/opex/efficiency (LDES Council); abatement costs per measure from Figs. 16-18 (chart-read, flagged VALUE READ FROM CHART, +/-5 USD/t) and Fig. 30 (printed); TRLs. Other-values: capex components of capture costs, 45Q/45V levelized credits, hydrogen T&S and ASU costs, wind/LDES/TES-energy inputs, emission factors and fuel prices, archetypical cracker/refinery facts, IRRs (Fig. 25), sector emissions. Measures: 10% fuel-efficiency lever and paybacks. Not loaded: bio-based fuels/chemicals and recycling life-cycle figures (Figs. 13-14, images, out of scope), workforce, policy, NGP compressor electrification (out of requested sectors; noted in measures), nascent options without numbers (rotary olefin cracker, ODH, plasma/microwave, electrochemical ammonia). Locator convention: printed page numbers (PDF page = printed + 8). Figures are raster images; Figs. 16-18, 25, 30, 34 were viewed rendered. Almost every number is reprinted (GREET 2022, EFI Foundation, DOE Hydrogen/LDES/Carbon Management Liftoff, Danish Energy Agency, LDES Council, NREL ATB, McKinsey)
